idea-plugin.name: Facturae 3.2.2 / Verifactu Lint
idea-plugin.description:
18 reglas sobre tu XML Facturae antes de que FACe lo devuelva

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Facturae 3.2.2 / Verifactu Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 18 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/facturae-verifactu-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com
